crossRefs.note: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair is…
His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.
How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!
So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;
yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless…
Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and…
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in…
I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

translations.web: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.
translations.bsb: You are altogether beautiful, my darling; in you there is no flaw.
translations.kjv: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot
translations.asv: Thou art all fair, my love; And there is no spot in thee.
